DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: mining plant
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A permanent mining operation that extracts and processes steel-bearing ore.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: farm
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: Organized fields that grow a crop selected by the player.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: logging camp
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A permanent camp that harvests and prepares timber from the surrounding region.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: oil derrick
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A drilling and refining operation that produces chemfuel.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: neutroamine collection station
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A chemical works that gathers and refines rare precursors into neutroamine.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: town center
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: The square, roads and shared buildings that hold a town together. It produces nothing by itself.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: automation hub
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A centralized control facility that coordinates the camp's automated machinery.
